statement.zh: 瑞士发掘传统将凯尔迈表述为含大型泥砖德福法神庙体量与相关城市/墓地布局的青铜时代中心（Bonnet/Honegger；Edwards 2004）。
statement.en: The Swiss excavation tradition frames Kerma as a Bronze Age centre with large mudbrick deffufa temple masses and related urban/cemetery layouts (Bonnet/Honegger; Edwards 2004).

statement.zh: 教科文将杰贝尔·Barkal 与纳帕塔区遗址群列为纳帕塔期宗教—王室景观核心（UNESCO 1073）。
statement.en: UNESCO lists Gebel Barkal and Napatan-region sites as a core Napatan religious–royal landscape (UNESCO 1073).

statement.zh: 教科文将麦罗埃岛考古遗址群（含麦罗埃城址与金字塔墓地等）列为麦罗埃期关键遗产（UNESCO 1336）。
statement.en: UNESCO lists the Archaeological Sites of the Island of Meroe (including the town and pyramid cemeteries) as a key Meroitic property (UNESCO 1336).

statement.zh: 综合与教科文将穆萨瓦拉特·苏弗拉表述为麦罗埃期大型神庙建筑群（UNESCO 1336；Welsby 1996）。
statement.en: Syntheses and UNESCO frame Musawwarat es-Sufra as a large Meroitic temple complex (UNESCO 1336; Welsby 1996).

statement.zh: 综合将纳卡表述为麦罗埃期神庙与定居中心之一（Welsby 1996；UNESCO 1336）。
statement.en: Syntheses frame Naqa as a Meroitic temple and settlement centre (Welsby 1996; UNESCO 1336).

statement.zh: 发掘回忆录传统将库鲁、努里等墓地作为纳帕塔王室埋葬序列的关键证据（Dunham MFA 传统；UNESCO 1073）。
statement.en: Excavation memoir tradition treats cemeteries such as El-Kurru and Nuri as key evidence for Napatan royal burial sequences (Dunham MFA tradition; UNESCO 1073).

statement.zh: 研究将麦罗埃文视为重建麦罗埃期行政与仪式实践的主要文字档案媒介之一（Rilly 传统；Török 1997）。
statement.en: Research treats Meroitic writing as a principal textual archive medium for reconstructing Meroitic administrative and ritual practice (Rilly tradition; Török 1997).

statement.zh: Edwards 综合将中尼罗表述为含凯尔迈、纳帕塔与麦罗埃等阶段的长时段考古序列（Edwards 2004）。
statement.en: Edwards’s synthesis frames the Middle Nile as a long archaeological sequence including Kerma, Napatan, and Meroitic phases (Edwards 2004).

statement.zh: 假说/叙事框架：纳帕塔统治者在埃及第二十五王朝语境中的政治角色需与墓地—神庙证据分开审读（Welsby/Török）。
statement.en: Hypothesis/narrative frame: the political role of Napatan rulers in Twenty-Fifth Dynasty Egyptian contexts must be read separately from cemetery–temple evidence (Welsby/Török).

claims.disclaimer: Hypothesis/narrative: Egyptian Dyn. 25 political reconstruction is text-forward and debated; not a site-find fact claim.

statement.zh: 《牛津古代努比亚手册》提供凯尔迈至麦罗埃考古与史学的近期章节级入口（Emberling & Williams 2021）。
statement.en: The Oxford Handbook of Ancient Nubia provides a recent chapter-level entry to Kerma-through-Meroe archaeology and historiography (Emberling & Williams 2021).
